title: Model
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero and the translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, create the first loop by drawing four lines: the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0459), the third line from (0.75, 0.0459) to (0.0, 0.0459), and the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0459) back to the origin. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with the Euler angles set to zero and translating it with the translation vector set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0039 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the model are a length of 0.7500000000000001, a width of 0.04594187992125985, and a height of 0.00390625. The final shape consists of a rectangular top with rounded corners and a cylindrical base.

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the rectangular top with rounded corners
r = r.box(0.75, 0.0459, 0.0039, centered=(False, False, False))

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0459) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0459) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0039)

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the profile of the part
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0013) \
     .threePointArc((0.0013, 0.0), (0.0026, 0.0013)) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0013) \
     .threePointArc((0.7513, 0.0), (0.7526, 0.0013)) \
     .lineTo(0.7526, 0.0446) \
     .threePointArc((0.7513, 0.0459), (0.75, 0.0446)) \
     .lineTo(0.0026, 0.0446) \
     .threePointArc((0.0013, 0.0459), (0.0, 0.0446)) \
     .close()

# Extrude the profile to create the body
r = r.extrude(0.0039)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
